Amber cells are editable execution fields. Add evidence before marking work or tests complete.

column6: Implementation outcome
The home screen groups tasks by person and encounter. Provider selection remains behind an eligible capability action.
Every patient-specific request carries person and encounter IDs validated against the active session context.
Voice capture has visible start, stop, playback and discard actions; the same fields accept typed or guided input.
The summary has confirmed facts, unresolved facts, recommendations and external actions as four distinct groups.
Language is a user preference; concepts and numeric values are language-neutral. Reviewed clinical strings have version IDs.
Show one state per destination plus a separate encounter-save state. Completion derives from required actions.
Persist a draft revision after each committed field change and store the last completed workflow step.
Critical actions use short labels and text plus icon status. Optional audio guidance stops before private playback.
Approval review lists purpose, recipient and exact record revisions. The worker can exclude an optional action.
Membership activation follows institutional verification; suspension increments a revocation version consumed by all services.
Policy input includes tenant, active role, assignment, programme, facility, purpose, action and resource sensitivity.
Use verified institutional authentication. Privileged users require MFA and recovery invalidates old sessions and devices.
Assignment changes carry effective dates and an explicit list of transferred open tasks with receiving ownership.
Matching returns candidates with evidence and score only as assistance; a verified link needs an authorised person decision.
Create a local UUID before external linking. Required local demographics permit explicit unknown where programme rules allow.
Proxy relationship includes relationship type, authority scope and evidence; household membership does not populate access grants.
Link correction appends a superseding relationship and generates a downstream repair list from lineage records.
Service identities have specific audiences and tools, rotated credentials and expiry; user tokens never become provider credentials.
Federated groups map through reviewed local role mappings; an external group cannot grant an unmapped clinical privilege.
Question equivalence requires the same semantic concept, person, episode, time window, unit and permitted purpose.

column5: Source and timing for every fact
column6: Each observation includes effective_at, recorded_at, source_type, verification, author and either value or absent_reason.
Extraction stores original segment references and draft confidence markers; confirmation is an explicit separate command.
Freshness is evaluated from effective time against the active pack requirement, not server receipt time.
Validation returns field paths and reason codes. Permitted outlier overrides require a scoped reviewer and reason.
Amendment records supersedes_id and reason. Lineage locates dependent plans, model results and submissions.
Compare expected record version before commit. Store both candidate revisions and a conflict object on collision.
Media progresses through uploaded, scanned, quality_checked and available. Extracted fields preserve source offsets.
Mapping packages contain source field, target field, transformation, unit and null semantics plus conformance fixtures.
Each action creates a field allowlist from the approved destination and purpose; a source fact can have several permitted uses.
Migration runs produce source totals, parsed totals, rejected rows, duplicate candidates and reversible import batch IDs.
Reuse opportunities are logged before question display, with reasons for reuse, recapture or blocked reuse.
Activation requires valid schemas, approved mappings, effective dates and named programme and clinical approvals.
Maternal records use an episode identifier and outcome state; unknown dates are stored as unknown with task follow-up.
TB screening and programme registration are separate workflows with separate confirmation and receipt states.
Measurements include device or observer, time, unit and context. Reported medicines are not signed prescriptions.
Scheduling joins compatible tasks into a visit plan while preserving programme due dates and completion conditions.
Enrolment stores eligibility_assessment and external_registration independently; only a verified receipt confirms the latter.
Pack migration computes affected open cases and applies an approved transition plan at an effective timestamp.
Additional packs use the same schema with their own definitions and reviewed value sets; pack IDs remain stable across versions.
Plan nodes are typed tool calls with dependencies, limits and authority class. Free text cannot create a new action type.
Retrieve only authorised fields referenced by the current task; cache keys include tenant, person, purpose and policy version.
The eligibility filter precedes cost or latency ranking and records excluded tools with machine-readable reasons.
Tool arguments validate against closed schemas; executable action names are resolved only from the trusted registry.
Approval hashes bind actor, resource versions, action, recipient, purpose and capability versions; the executor checks them.
Persist a checkpoint and action identity for each step. Resume reads receipts before selecting pending steps.
Enforce max_steps, deadline and budget in the executor independently of model output; cancellation records residual work.
Store each model result separately. A conflict policy creates a human review task for incompatible outputs.
Recommendation records contain source fact IDs and rule or model version references; unsupported text is excluded.

column5: Clinical workflow continuity without an LLM
column6: Structured capture, cached approved guidance and draft referrals operate without a model dependency.
Natural language reporting resolves to approved metric IDs and filters, then applies the same report policy checks.
Agent release manifests pin prompts, tools, safety tests, model release IDs and rollback compatibility.
A manifest version is immutable and owned by one verified provider; missing evidence keeps its activation state incomplete.
Eligibility predicates cover role, age basis, population, language, device, geography, quality and required history.
Evidence and approval are distinct records tied to provider version, population, study setting and deployment scope.
Lifecycle transitions require scoped roles; registration and deployment approval are independent permissions.
Validate request and response against pinned schemas, request correlation, media format and result semantics.

column5: Input quality and inability to assess
column6: Capture quality failures carry retry guidance from approved provider instructions and do not yield clinical risk values.
Each invocation stores manifest version, provider release ID, input hash and adapter version; mutable aliases are not accepted alone.
Build payloads from manifest-required fields intersected with purpose permissions; log references rather than raw payloads.
Results are immutable references with provider attribution. Switching a provider creates a new invocation, never rewrites history.
Suspension sets an effective timestamp, prevents new admissions and emits tasks for affected pending or recent encounters.

column5: Provider self-service in a controlled environment
column6: Provider workspaces allow manifest drafts and synthetic fixtures only; live activation stays in deployment governance.
Budget admission reserves the maximum approved call cost and settles actual charges or releases unused reservation.
Knowledge entries require source, version, applicability, reviewer and expiry. Retrieval filters by active local approval.
The protocol engine evaluates reviewed decision tables; the LLM receives the decision and evidence for explanation only.
Urgent protocol actions have a local route and contact record; provider waits cannot delay their display.
Clinical command policy uses verified credentials and locally approved scope, not role label alone.
Reviews capture accepted or rejected recommendation, reason, clinician identity and exact evidence snapshot.
Every capability has its own performance thresholds and evaluation population; administrative extraction scores are separate.
Composition review evaluates joint workflow hazards, missing input handling and disagreement rules.
Safety case intake is available from the encounter and creates containment and follow-up assignments.
Connector activation requires owner agreement, allowed operations, exact environment, receipt examples and support contact.
The operation allowlist independently grants search, read, create, amend, delete, export and status lookup.
Acceptance requires a verified destination business receipt linked to payload revision and action ID.
Use a persistent logical action ID and destination idempotency mechanism; uncertain outcomes enter reconciliation.
Each external action has its own receipt and retry policy; successful actions remain accepted during another failure.
Inbound updates retain source version and effective time; conflicts produce a review record against local pending changes.
Schema upgrades validate fixtures and pending payload compatibility before activation; incompatible work pauses visibly.
File exports and assisted hand-offs retain a local action ID and prepared state until external acceptance evidence exists.
Per-destination allowlists distinguish aggregate measures from person-level transactions and remove unrelated fields.
Connector manifests pin the receiving system profile, terminology release and validator configuration.
Canonical entities map to destination records through explicit versioned transformations with provenance links.
Source identifiers, author, effective time, original status and transformation versions survive import and export.
ABDM module roles are flags on a verified connector deployment; enabling ABHA does not enable HIP or HIU.
ABHA verification and record-linking follow the onboarded flow with explicit user confirmation where required.
Validate consent requester, provider, purpose, data types, period, frequency, expiry and current status before retrieval.
Facility and professional identifiers include registry source, verification state and deployment association.

column5: ABDM FHIR conformance and version control
column6: FHIR package hash, profile URL, terminology and validator version are retained with each validation result.
HIP publication registers eligible local records and care contexts, then fulfils only verified authorised requests.
HIU retrieval tracks consent and data-flow transactions, decrypts through the authorised boundary and validates each bundle.
Connector profiles declare resource types, search keys, operations, amendments, pagination, limits and receipt semantics.
External version checks or reconciliation protect EHR writes; conflicts never default to last-write-wins.
Legacy adapters declare batch latency, source artefacts, acknowledgements and manual review obligations.
Unmapped terminology has an explicit state and blocks destinations requiring a code until reviewed mapping exists.
Expose conformance, sandbox, security review, onboarding and live acceptance as separate evidence fields.
Offline availability is a manifest of cached records, protocols and commands under a signed device lease.
Draft and queue mutations commit atomically to encrypted storage before the saved indicator appears.
Lease checks use signed server time plus monotonic elapsed time; clock rollback or untrusted reboot requires online verification.
Pending media carries its purpose, consent reference, capability version and expiry; all are rechecked before upload.
Sync envelopes include command ID, dependencies, base version and local sequence; per-item results return independently.
Delayed commands recheck active assignment, patient link, clinical freshness, pack version and recipient permission.
Device switching clears decrypted memory and locks the cache. Remote revocation is enforced on next contact or lease expiry.
Capacity reserves space for structured records before new media. Pending work is never evicted for cache refresh.
Task creation requires an owner or a monitored assignment queue with a service-level escalation rule.
Directory entries require last_verified_at and supported services; expired availability is labelled and escalated.
Referral transitions attach evidence_type, evidence_ref and verifying actor; closure needs outcome or coded unresolved disposition.
Due-work calculations record schedule version and timezone; escalation retains prior owner and reason for delay.
Deduplication joins only equivalent person, purpose, destination and time-window tasks and retains both programme links.
Communication preferences are per person, purpose and channel, with shared-phone disclosure limits.
Channel adapters record delivery and opt-out status separately from patient acknowledgement or service completion.
Activity evidence distinguishes performed, verified, claimed and submitted; corrections invalidate derived claims.
Exceptions are indexed by owner, type, age, state and permitted person reference with direct recovery actions.
Metric definitions version numerator, denominator, exclusions, source grain, cutoff and suppression.
Each report shows source refresh time and incomplete feeds; delayed records revise a new report version.
Aggregate policy combines minimum cohort rules, protected dimensions and query-history controls against differencing.
Exports contain metric definition version, scope, date window and row count, with expiring authorised download.
Prioritisation returns reasons and uncertainty for human allocation; neither payment nor eligibility is automatically changed.
Operational metrics use event references and redacted counters; patient content never becomes general product telemetry.
Configuration is tenant-scoped and versioned; validate referenced roles, packs, capabilities and connector profiles before publish.

column6: Authority records distinguish consent-based flows from other approved processing bases and specify allowed purpose and recipients.
Notices have language and version, and record the actor, relationship, decision, time and purpose.
Revocation invalidates pending disclosures immediately online and schedules device and recipient disposition actions.
Sensitive data classes and proxy rules are evaluated before views, exports, notifications and model payload construction.
TLS, envelope encryption and secret references protect data; key rotation and access are audited separately.
Every object query and attachment token enforces tenant and record policy; database RLS supplies a second tenant boundary.
A structured logging allowlist excludes clinical values, credentials, raw prompts and recording bytes.
A material command commits its audit record atomically; durable read-access audit precedes sensitive data return.
Retention jobs require record class, schedule, legal-hold checks and evidence of actual disposal at each storage tier.
Rights cases verify requester identity, track affected custodians and deadlines, and record evidence-backed resolution.
Exceptional access requires an approved role, purpose, scope, expiry and independent retrospective review.
Provider onboarding records dependencies, subprocessors, update obligations and vulnerability response ownership.
Incident records retain timeline, containment, affected scope and jurisdiction-specific notification decisions.
Routing policy constrains provider, storage, backup and support regions before any transfer.
Observation validation requires a real captured value or explicit missingness; model-derived values carry derivation references.
Consequential commands require a recently confirmed patient context tied to the encounter revision.
Approval includes hashes of facts, action, recipient, purpose, rules and model versions.
Local task cancellation records remaining external obligations; it never rewrites destination receipts.
Result displays preserve provider-specific scales and calibration notes; unsupported score comparisons are disallowed.
Execution performs current policy and authority checks even when the planning-stage checks passed.
Environment and output-use labels travel with every model result; live action builders reject test or shadow results.
The action catalogue excludes autonomous benefits, sanctions and employment decisions.
Measure successful authenticated core probes and real requests over a calendar month; publish planned maintenance and dependency failures separately.
